sn46.48:1.1: Adiccassa bhikkhave udayato etam pubbaṅgamaṃ etam pubbanimittam yadidam aruṇuggaṃ ||
sn46.48:1.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sattannam bhojjhaṅgānam uppādāya etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idaṃ kalyāṇamittatā || || 3.
sn46.48:1.3: Kalyāṇamittassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ satta bojjhaṅge bhāvessati || satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkarissati || ||
sn46.48:1.4: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto satta bojjhaṅge bhāveti- -bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn46.48:1.5: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || la-pe ||
sn46.48:1.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto sattabojjhaṅge bhāveti sattabojjhaṅge bahulīkarotī ti || || 2.
